tools.description:
List work orders with optional filters (site, status, asset, priority, dates).
    status accepts OPEN / APPROVED_PENDING; page_size=0 returns all matches in one call.
tools.name: list_workorders
tools.title: List Work Orders

tools.description: Get a single work order by number and site.
tools.name: get_workorder
tools.title: Get Work Order

tools.description: List the child tasks of a parent work order.
tools.name: get_workorder_tasks
tools.title: Get Work Order Tasks

tools.description: Actual labor/material/service/tool cost breakdown for a work order.
tools.name: get_workorder_costs
tools.title: Get Work Order Costs

tools.description: Estimated vs actual hours and cost variance for a work order.
tools.name: get_workorder_actuals_vs_planned
tools.title: Get Work Order Actuals vs Planned

tools.description: Site KPIs: totals, backlog, overdue, avg completion, priority/asset breakdowns.
tools.name: get_workorder_kpis
tools.title: Get Work Order KPIs

tools.description: Scheduled (non-terminal) work orders in a date window, bucketed by day.
tools.name: get_schedule_calendar
tools.title: Get Schedule Calendar

tools.description: Work orders assigned to a given technician (labor code).
tools.name: get_my_assigned_workorders
tools.title: Get My Assigned Work Orders

tools.description:
Read the FCC failure-code reference catalog from CouchDB.

    Omit ``code`` to list all available failure codes, or pass an exact code
    such as ``FC001``. Matching is case-insensitive and CouchDB metadata is not
    returned.
tools.name: get_failure_codes
tools.title: Get Failure Codes

tools.description: Create a work order (status WAPPR). Attach aob_source provenance (agent/trigger/evidence).
tools.name: generate_work_order
tools.title: Generate Work Order

tools.description: Update mutable fields on a work order.
tools.name: update_workorder
tools.title: Update Work Order

tools.description: Assign a technician (adds a wplabor line).
tools.name: assign_technician
tools.title: Assign Technician

tools.description: Close a work order (-> COMP) with actuals and resolution.
tools.name: close_workorder
tools.title: Close Work Order
